title: Point currents and their support
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, U ⊆ ℝ^P open, x ∈ U, and ξ₀ ∈ Λ_n(ℝ^P) = (Λⁿℝ^P)* (MultiVector P n, a continuous linear functional on n-covectors). Then (a) there is D ∈ 𝒟_n(U) (a GeometricCurrentOn U n: a linear functional on 𝒟ⁿ(U), sequentially continuous in Simon's test-form topology) with D(ω) = ξ₀(ω(x)) for every ω ∈ 𝒟ⁿ(U); (b) if ξ₀ ≠ 0, then every D ∈ 𝒟_n(U) with D(ω) = ξ₀(ω(x)) for all ω ∈ 𝒟ⁿ(U) has spt D = {x}. Here spt D is the support of Simon 6.2.11 as frozen: U minus the union of all open W with W̄ compact, W̄ ⊆ U, and D(ω) = 0 whenever tsupport ω ⊆ W.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (x : Euclid P) (ξ₀ : MultiVector P n), IsOpen U → x ∈ U → (∃ D : GeometricCurrentOn U n, ∀ ω : TestFormOn U n, D ω = ξ₀ ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) x)) ∧ ∀ D : GeometricCurrentOn U n, (∀ ω : TestFormOn U n, D ω = ξ₀ ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) x)) → ξ₀ ≠ 0 → D.support = {x}
